name: mis
description: Mature Interaction System — opt-in sexual interaction verbs, horniness/arousal, climax events, wash, MIS-gated appearance notes. The engine keeps only the consent flag (server/engine/mis.js).

wash.note: Declaration-only specializedAction on water_source furniture, so a sink advertises WASH on examine. The verb stays an ordinary plugin command because it accepts more than furniture (falling rain, a carried water item) and does more than MIS cleanup (blood, acid residue) — the registry row exists purely for discoverability.

inject.note: KNOWN GAP: gated on a carried item tagged , not on anything in the room, so there is nothing to hang an examine hint off. Discovered via the item description and the refusal line when no site is named.
